title: The Judds: Their Final Concert
overview: The Judds' historic Farewell Concert originally took place on December 4, 1991, at the Murphy Center in Murfreesboro, Tennessee. This legendary final performance was broadcast as a TV special, capturing the iconic mother-daughter country duo at the peak of their career. Featuring their number one hits: "Mama He's Crazy," "Rockin' With The Rhythm Of The Rain," "Maybe Your Baby's Got The Blues," "Have Mercy," "Let Me Tell You About Love," "Love Is Alive," "Turn It Loose," "Change of Heart," "Why Not Me," "Grandpa (Tell Me 'Bout The Good Old Days)," and other favorites.
